integrity: The source auxiliary problem, Wolfe conditions, continuous existence theorem, and one-sided dyadic Algorithm 1 grid were checked directly in the full text. The frontier follows from exact scalar algebra; the bundled script only replays the formulas on finite test sets.
scientific_limitations: The exact frontier is for the scalar, single-objective, single-scenario quadratic specialization and the standard Wolfe conditions. It establishes a scale-completeness obstruction for the published trial grid but does not classify multidimensional robust max-of-quadratics instances.
title: Exact scale frontier for the one-sided Wolfe grid in robust steepest descent
